user.title: Connect Spooly
user.description: How do you want to connect Home Assistant with Spooly?

oauth.title: Sign in with Spooly
oauth.description: Spooly opens in a new window, where you allow access. Home Assistant never sees your password.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Only change this if you are working against a test environment.

key.title: Enter a key
key.description: Create the key in Spooly under Settings, Devices & keys. Switch on "Can also change" if Home Assistant should be allowed to change spools.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Only change this if you are working against a test environment.

reauth_oauth.title: Sign in again
reauth_oauth.description: Spooly rejected the connection, or it needs more permissions. Sign in again and allow changes.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter a new key
reauth_confirm.description: Spooly rejected the key. It was probably revoked, or it may only read. Create a new one in Spooly (with "Can also change" if you want to change spools) and enter it here.

error.invalid_auth: The key is wrong or has been revoked.
error.pro_expired: Spooly Pro has expired. The key works again once Pro is active.
error.api_disabled: The API is not enabled for your account yet.
error.rate_limited: You have reached today's limit of calls. Try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Spooly cannot be reached. Check the internet connection.
error.invalid_url: The address must start with https://.
error.unknown: Spooly answered unexpectedly. Details are in the log.

abort.already_configured: This Spooly account or key is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The connection to Spooly has been renewed.
abort.wrong_account: This is a different Spooly account than the one that was set up. Sign in with the same account.
abort.pro_expired: Spooly Pro has expired. Sign in again once Pro is active.
abort.api_disabled: The API is not enabled for your account yet.
abort.rate_limited: You have reached today's limit of calls. Try again later.
abort.cannot_connect: Spooly cannot be reached. Check the internet connection.
abort.unknown: Spooly answered unexpectedly. Details are in the log.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Creating the sign-in address took too long.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no address that Spooly can send you back to. Check the setup of My Home Assistant.
abort.oauth_failed: Spooly did not accept the sign-in.
abort.oauth_timeout: Spooly took too long to answer.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: The sign-in is not available right now. Try again later.

pro_expired.message: Spooly Pro has expired. Values stay as they are and return once Pro is active.

api_disabled.message: The API is not enabled for your Spooly account.

rate_limited.message: Spooly has limited requests for now. The next attempt follows later.

no_write_permission.message: Spooly only allows this connection to read. Home Assistant now offers to sign in again (Settings, Devices & services, Spooly). Allow changes there.

auth_failed.message: Spooly rejected the sign-in. Home Assistant offers to sign in again.

change_limit.message: Spooly is limiting changes right now. Try again in {seconds} seconds.

tare_missing.message: This spool has no empty spool weight yet. Set the tare in Spooly first, or give the weight without the spool.

slot_autopilot_off.message: Slots can only be changed while the slot autopilot is active in Spooly.

other_color.message: The printer reports a different color in the slot than the spool has. If the assignment is right anyway, switch on "Confirm color".

spool_archived.message: The spool is archived. Restore it first.

busy.message: The slot was changed at the same time. Try again in a moment.

above_spool_size.message: The weight would be larger than the spool.

gross_not_above_tare.message: The gross weight must be larger than the empty spool weight.

spool_in_print.message: The spool is probably in a running print and can only be changed afterwards.

not_found.message: Spooly does not know this spool, slot or maintenance task (anymore).

invalid_input.message: Spooly rejected the values. Check them.

not_a_spool.message: Pick the device of a spool. Printers and the Spooly device itself do not work.

not_a_slot.message: Pick the sensor of a slot.

different_accounts.message: The spool and the slot belong to different Spooly accounts.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Spooly integration is not loaded right now.

weight_exactly_one.message: Give either grams or gross weight, not both and not neither.

location_not_found.message: Spooly does not know this storage location. Use the name as shown in Spooly, including the path.

location_ambiguous.message: Several storage locations have this name. Use the full path or the id.

not_a_task.message: Pick the sensor of a maintenance task.

set_weight.name: Set weight
set_weight.description: Sets the remaining weight of a spool. Give either the filament weight or the gross weight from a scale.

grams.name: Filament weight
grams.description: Remaining filament in grams, without the empty spool.

gross_grams.name: Gross weight
gross_grams.description: Weight of the spool on the scale in grams. Needs a known empty spool weight in Spooly.

refill.name: Refill
refill.description: Adds grams to the remaining weight of a spool.

assign_slot.name: Assign to slot
assign_slot.description: Puts a spool into a printer slot. Needs the slot autopilot in Spooly.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: The slot sensor of the printer.

confirm_color.name: Confirm color
confirm_color.description: Assign even if the printer reports a different color.

clear_slot.name: Empty slot
clear_slot.description: Removes the spool from a slot. The spool stays in Spooly. Needs the slot autopilot.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: The slot sensor of the printer.

move.name: Move
move.description: Moves a spool to a storage location.

location.name: Storage location
location.description: Name as shown in Spooly, including the path, or the id of the location.

archive.name: Archive
archive.description: Archives a spool. It leaves the active stock but is not deleted.

restore.name: Restore
restore.description: Brings an archived spool back into the active stock.

device_id.name: Spool
device_id.description: The device of the archived spool.

complete_maintenance.name: Maintenance done
complete_maintenance.description: Marks a maintenance task as done. Pick the sensor of the task.

task.name: Task
task.description: The sensor of the maintenance task.

action.name: What was done
action.description: Replaced, cleaned or checked. Without it Spooly uses the usual action of the task.

notes.name: Note
notes.description: Free text, saved with the entry in Spooly.

snooze_maintenance.name: Snooze maintenance
snooze_maintenance.description: Postpones a maintenance task. Pick the sensor of the task.

task.name: Task
task.description: The sensor of the maintenance task.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days the task stays quiet.
